source: Oklahoma Corporation Commission ALL_UIC_WELLS and COMMERCIAL_UIC_WELLS (active Class II UIC wells) joined by API number to the OCC annual UIC injection volume workbook
volume_note: Sum of the twelve monthly Vol columns in the OCC workbook for saltwater wells (Form 1012). The workbook does not state a unit; OCC UIC volume reports are in barrels, so the figure is read as barrels. Gas-injection wells are excluded. Treat totals as ANALYTIC ASSESSMENT.
